utility.notes: San Juan Capistrano is absent from SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (re-verified directly this session, consistent with the same finding for neighboring San Clemente and Dana Point). The city's own solar permit page directly confirms SDG&E as the interconnecting utility, requiring an 'SDG&E Work Order' for panel upgrades.

generation_supplier.notes: Neither San Diego Community Power nor Clean Energy Alliance (the two CCAs operating in SDG&E territory) name San Juan Capistrano as a member city this session. Left null rather than asserted either way.
